content: temporalio Python SDK 1.32.0 current on PyPI, requires Python>=3.10. Temporal server v1.31.2 current (temporalio/server and temporalio/auto-setup docker images). Pattern: FastAPI endpoint starts workflow via Temporal client; workflow code must be deterministic/replay-safe, all I/O (DB calls, HTTP) goes in Activities not Workflows; use workflow ID for idempotency; run Temporal worker as separate process/container from FastAPI app.
